title: Choose the visual world for Wepilo
question: The roll assigned Hut Board. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Hut Board
options.lineage: Himalayan teahouse and mountain-hut booking boards
options.thesis: The warden's board: every night, every bunk, every guest at a glance.
options.viewport: Pine-green side rail; home opens on a Today board of three lanes (reply, confirm, departing) with seat pegs per departure.
options.risk: Pegs and amber markers turn into decoration if they appear anywhere they don't count something real.

raised.raise: The amber marker and the green fill are only ever on things you can act on; everything else stays neutral.
One visible 8px cell grid governs board lanes, tables and peg rows, so every count lines up.
Capacity is a hard limit: a departure's peg row can't overflow, and a full row reads full at a glance.

options.label: Survey Sheet
options.lineage: 1:50,000 topographic survey sheets of trekking regions
options.thesis: The agency's business read like a route map: contours, waypoints, elevation.
options.viewport: Light survey-green ground; departures as route lines with waypoint dots; bookings trend drawn as an elevation profile.
options.risk: Maps are the obvious travel motif, and contour texture easily drifts into costume.

options.label: Warm Consumer Surface
options.thesis: Soft cards on a warm ground, plain words, and one bright colour that always means 'press me'.
options.viewport: Single column of rounded cards: To reply, To confirm, Departing soon, then stats.
options.case: Strong on clarity for non-technical owners; weaker on identity, reading close to any friendly app.
options.risk: Lands near the generic soft-SaaS look you asked to avoid.

options.label: Data-sublime field
options.risk: Cold and technical for agency owners.
options.case: Loses on both axes: owners don't identify with it and it hides the task.
options.kept: Tabular numerals everywhere numbers are compared.

options.label: Crouwel grid specimen
options.case: Loses on both axes for a daily ops screen.

options.label: Cassette j-card
options.thesis: Sides that must not overflow the tape.
options.case: Loses on both axes; unrelated to travel work.
options.kept: Hard capacity limits that read at a glance.

options.label: Centre-rail reference setting
options.thesis: Two columns round a keyed rail.
options.risk: Reads as a book, not a dashboard.
options.kept: Every state is a printed mark, never just a colour.

options.label: Character goods catalog
options.risk: Too playful, which you ruled out.
options.kept: Each item has fixed, findable furniture.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean admin dashboard of the kind every SaaS ships, executed well.
canonCard.viewport: Grey sidebar, four stat cards, a bookings chart and recent lists.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from other admin templates by design.
